currentlyFailing: Would be rejected if closed now
waterfallHint: Preferences are paid by seniority; the remainder is split by shares. Options, warrants and treasury shares are ignored.
notConnected: Not connected to an organization yet.
ownershipHint: Node width is fully diluted ownership. Boxes under a company are its recorded owners; the full look-through is on the Beneficial owners page.
tokenHint: Run `npm run dev-token -- <orgId>` for a local development token.
authentic: Authentic: this certificate matches the register.
notAuthentic: Not authentic: the hash does not match the register.
mfaPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
certPrefixHint: 2 to 12 letters or digits, e.g. ACME gives ACME-000001.
securityIntro: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter the code it shows. Data stays locked until this is done.
mfaRequiredBanner: Finish two-factor setup to unlock your data.
uboGaps: Ownership not traced to a natural person
uboEditorHint: Record who owns each company on the register. Percentages are of that company's capital and votes; voting defaults to the economic share when left empty.
uboNoCorporate: No corporate shareholders on the register.
succIntro: A rule converts shares from one class to another when a trigger event happens, optionally into a beneficiary's name. Preview shows exactly what will change; executing retires the old certificates and issues new ones that link back to them.
succAllHolders: All holders of the source class
succRatioHint: New shares received per old share given up.
succConfirm: Execute this rule? The old certificates will be retired and new ones issued. This cannot be undone.
vaultHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG, DOCX or text, up to 10 MB. Each file's SHA-256 is recorded and checked on every download.
vaultTooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MB.
forgotIntro: Enter your account email. If it matches an account, we will send a link that works once and expires in 30 minutes.
forgotSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
resetMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
resetDone: Your password has been changed. Two-factor authentication is still required to sign in.
resetNoToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
econVsVotingHint: Share of fully diluted equity against share of votes, largest holders first.
emptyConnect: Connect your organization to see its register.
importIntro: Bring an existing register in from a spreadsheet. Check the file first; nothing is saved until you import.
importHoldersHelp: One row per shareholder. Holders already on the register (same name) are skipped. Import shareholders before issued shares.
importIssuancesHelp: One row per issuance. Holder and share class must already exist and be spelled the same. Each row becomes a numbered certificate.
importErrorsFound: The file has errors. Fix them and check again; nothing was saved.
transfersIntro: Move shares between holders, or buy them back into the company treasury. Each move retires the old certificates and issues new ones, so the history stays intact.
transferDone: Transfer recorded. New certificates were issued.
buyBackDone: Buy-back recorded. The shares are now in the treasury.
obClassHint: Define Ordinary shares or any other class.
obHoldersHint: Import from a spreadsheet or add them one by one.
obResHint: Put a decision to a vote.
obUboHint: Check the UBO register for gaps.
roundsIntro: Model a new round before you agree it: who is diluted, what the new investor gets, and what the option pool costs. Nothing is saved.
roundPoolHint: Created before the investment, so it dilutes existing holders, not the new investor.
roundNote: Fully diluted shares: issued shares plus options, warrants and convertibles. This is a model, not an offer; check the term sheet with counsel.
optionsIntro: Option grants and how much of each has vested. Exercising turns vested options into shares and issues new certificates.
optionsNone: No option grants yet. Issue a certificate with the instrument type Option, then set its vesting here.
optionsExerciseDone: Options exercised. New share certificates were issued.
sigStatementDefault: I have read this document and confirm it.
sigHint: Enter a new code from your authenticator app. A code you already used to sign in will not work; wait for the next one. This signature is recorded in the register; it is not a qualified electronic signature.
confirmOpenDetail: Members can vote until the deadline. The title and terms can no longer be edited.
confirmCloseTitle: Close voting and record the result?
confirmCloseDetail: The outcome is decided on the votes cast so far. This cannot be undone.
confirmIssueDetail: It is written to the register and audit trail and cannot be edited afterwards.
toastInvited: Member invited. Share the temporary password with them securely.
portalIntro: Your holdings, certificates and the votes waiting for you.
confirmImportTitle: Import this file into the register?
confirmImportDetail: Each row is written to the register and audit trail. Imported certificates cannot be removed afterwards.
confirmMoveDetail: The old certificates are retired and new ones issued. This cannot be undone.
confirmExerciseDetail: Vested options become shares and new certificates are issued. This cannot be undone.
confirmScheduleDetail: Vesting is calculated from it from now on.
confirmSignDetail: Your signature is recorded in the register and cannot be withdrawn.
confirmRemindTitle: Email a reminder to everyone who has not voted?
confirmRemindDetail: Each member and shareholder who can still vote gets an email with a link to this resolution. You can send one reminder an hour; an automatic one also goes out in the last 24 hours.
guideIntro: How to run your register, step by step. Each step opens the page where you do it.
guide2faB: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code. Data stays locked until this is done.
guideClassB: Add Ordinary, Preferred or Non-voting classes with par value, votes per share and authorized shares. Add a Treasury class if you will buy shares back.
guideHoldersB: Import them from a spreadsheet: download the template, check the file, then import. Or add them one by one on Setup.
guideIssueB: Record who owns what. Import existing holdings on the Issued shares tab, or issue one certificate at a time. Certificates cannot be edited after issue.
guideMembersB: Add a corporate secretary, board members, auditors or shareholders. The temporary password is shown once; send it securely.
guideCapB: Issued and fully diluted ownership with voting power. Pick an As of date to see it as it stood in the past, and click a holder to open their ledger. Export it as CSV or PDF. Press Ctrl+K anywhere to search.
guideTransferB: Choose seller, buyer, class and quantity. Old certificates are retired and new ones issued. To reverse, record the opposite transfer.
guideOptionsB: Issue a certificate with instrument type Option, set its vesting schedule, then exercise vested options into shares.
guideRoundB: Enter pre-money, investment and option pool, and add any SAFEs or convertible notes, to see the price per share and everyone's dilution. Save up to four scenarios and compare them side by side. Nothing is saved to the register.
guideExitB: Enter an exit value to see what each class and holder receives after liquidation preferences.
guideResB: Set the majority, quorum and deadline, create the draft, then open voting. Terms are locked once voting opens. After it closes, download the minutes as a bilingual PDF.
guideVoteB: Members vote For, Against or Abstain; votes are final. Close the vote to record Passed or Rejected, and collect signatures.
guideSuccB: Define what happens to shares on a founder event or IPO. Preview the exact changes, then execute with an authorising resolution.
guideUboB: Record who owns each corporate shareholder, set the threshold, fix any gaps, and export the report as CSV or PDF.
guideVaultB: Upload articles, agreements, minutes and licences. Each file's fingerprint is checked on every download.
guideAuditB: Every change is logged in a hash chain. Hash chain intact means nothing has been altered.
guideHoldingsB: Your shares, fully diluted position, ownership and voting power in one place.
guideHolderVoteB: Open votes are listed under Votes waiting for you. Click one, choose For, Against or Abstain, and confirm. Votes are final.
guideHolderCertB: Download each certificate as a PDF, or open Signatures to sign it with a fresh authenticator code.
guideConfirmNote: Anything permanent, such as issuing, transfers, voting or signing, asks you to confirm first and shows what will happen.
subCapTable: Every holder by class, issued and fully diluted, with voting power.
subMembers: People who can sign in to this organization and what they are allowed to do.
subSetup: Share classes and shareholders that the rest of the register is built on.
subCertificates: Every share certificate issued, each with a verifiable QR code and PDF.
subResolutions: Board and shareholder resolutions, weighted by voting power.
subAudit: A tamper-evident, hash-chained record of every change to the register.
intgHint: Connect reporting tools and other systems. Only founders can manage these.
intgKeysHint: Read-only access for reporting and BI tools. Send the key in an X-API-Key header.
intgKeyShown: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.
intgHooksHint: We send a signed POST to your https address when these events happen. Failed deliveries are retried for about 15 hours.
intgHookSecretShown: Copy this signing secret now. It will not be shown again.
intgHookTestSent: Test event queued. It is sent within a few seconds.
intgConfirmDelete: Delete this webhook and its delivery log?
intgConfirmRevoke: Revoke this key? Anything using it stops working immediately.
subApprovals: Changes to the register wait here for a second person to approve them.
apprRequire: Require a second person to approve
apprRequireHelp: When on, issuing certificates, transfers, buy-backs and option exercises are held until a different founder or board member approves. If nobody else could approve, changes go through directly.
apprWaitingOther: Waiting for a founder or board member to approve.
confirmApprOnDetail: From now on these changes wait for a second person to approve them. Records already in the register are not affected.
confirmApprOffDetail: Changes take effect immediately again. Changes already waiting stay in the list.
confirmApproveTitle: Approve and carry out this change?
confirmApproveDetail: It is applied to the register now and cannot be undone.
confirmRejectDetail: Nothing is changed in the register.
toastSentForApproval: Sent for approval. It takes effect once a second person approves it.
subIssue: Record who owns new shares. A numbered certificate with a verification QR code is created.
transfersHelpTitle: What happens when you record this
transfersHelp1: The seller's certificate is retired and a new one is issued to the buyer. Any shares the seller keeps get a fresh certificate too, so the history stays complete.
transfersHelp2: Attach a passed resolution if your articles require board approval for transfers.
transfersHelp3: A buy-back moves the shares into the company's treasury at the price you enter.
transfersHelp4: If two-person approval is on, the change waits on the Approvals page until someone else approves it.
transfersHelp5: Afterwards, open the buyer's certificate history to download a transfer instrument as a PDF.
issueHelp1: Check the holder, class and quantity first. Once issued, a certificate is written to the register and the audit trail and cannot be edited.
issueHelp2: Par value and the class's authorized share limit are checked. If you go over either, the reason appears here.
issueHelp3: Each certificate gets its own number and a QR code. Anyone can scan it to check the certificate against the register.
issueHelp4: If two-person approval is on, the certificate is issued after another founder or board member approves it.
capHistoricNote: Showing the register as it stood at the end of
ledgerEmpty: No certificates for this holder yet.
lineageIntro: What this certificate replaced and what replaced it, oldest first.
roundConvertiblesHint: They convert at the lowest of the round price, the discounted price and the cap price (cap divided by shares before the round). Converted shares sit in the pre-money, so existing holders carry them.
roundResultsEmpty: Results appear here after you run a simulation.
roundScenarioMax: Four scenarios at most. Remove one to save another.
roundScenarioNote: Scenarios are kept on this page only and are lost when you leave it.
plannerHelp: Plan the hires you want to grant options to. Each person gets a share of the company after the round; the total is the pool you need.
plannerTooBig: The pool can be at most 50%.
addCompanyIntro: Start another company under this login. You become its founder; each company has its own register, members and audit trail.
notFoundBody: That address does not exist, or it has moved. Go back to the dashboard and try again.
errorTitle: This page could not be shown
errorBody: Something went wrong while drawing this page. Your data is safe. Try again, and if it keeps happening, sign out and back in.
guideCompaniesB: Click the company name in the top bar to switch to another company on the same login, without signing in again, or to add a new one. Each company keeps its own register, members and audit trail.
guideApprB: A founder can switch on two-person approval. Issuing, transfers, buy-backs and option exercises then wait until a different founder or board member approves them.
maintenanceReadOnly: The register is read-only during this time.
changelogIntro: Every release in plain language, newest first.
thresholdTwoThirds: Two-thirds (66.7% or more, Saudi extraordinary assembly)
logoHint: Shown in the menu and top bar for everyone in this company. PNG, JPEG or WEBP, up to 512 KB, square works best.
logoRemoveConfirm: Remove the logo? The company goes back to its initials.
logoBadType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WEBP image.
logoTooBig: The logo must be 512 KB or smaller.
